info.title: Transloadit API
info.description: Transloadit is a file processing service for web and mobile applications. The API allows you to create and manage Assemblies (file processing jobs), Templates (reusable processing instructions), Template Credentials, Assembly Notifications, and billing information.

post.description: Create a new file processing Assembly. Upload files and specify processing steps.

params.description: JSON-encoded params with auth, steps, template_id, notify_url, fields

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid auth key or signature

get.description: List Assemblies for the account, sorted by creation date descending. Supports filtering and pagination.

parameters.description: Filter assemblies created after this date

parameters.name: todate
